How to use

To use the Thermal And Cold Insulated Delica Pot, simply fill it with your desired hot or cold food and securely close the lid to maintain temperature. It is perfect for carrying soups, stews, salads, or chilled desserts. Always ensure the lid is tightly fastened before transport to prevent leaks.
